plan_item: P-88 (A1-numerics): k_max / truncation-shape convergence of route-B DDO154 at fixed source and fixed parameters, at the A2 seed-scan anchor (gamma factor 3)
status: PREREGISTERED_BEFORE_ANY_ANCHOR_RESULT. Sealed (SEAL_RECORD.json) while the C2 case (A2_ANCHOR_F3_RUN_V001) is still running and before any other case is launched. Thresholds, gates and the decision rule are fixed here and must not change after any result exists; a change is a new version with its reason recorded.

supersedes.why: Independent check CHECK_V001.md (calibration_prep_c2_0470/kmax_convergence) verdict PASS_WITH_CORRECTIONS: D1-D8 applied here (D13 also applied because rule 5 was ambiguous); root decisions (a)-(e) of the Claude2 coordinator applied here. No V001 case was run at the anchor; the one V001-kit call, KMAX_C2_A2_RUN_V001, is at the seed V002 point (gamma 2.94e41, s=1), ended BLOCKED per its monitor log, and is not a case of this matrix.
changes: ROOT (a): per-row threshold tau_i = 0.25*sigma_i replaces the single tau = 0.05 km/s; tau_inner_i = tau_i; shape-agreement bound 2*tau_i; Picard gate unchanged at 0.0125 km/s absolute.
ROOT (b): all cases at the A2 seed-scan factor-3 anchor; physical and brackets blocks copied verbatim from the base spec below.
ROOT (c): V3 driver clause amended: grids <= 80 nodes/axis may run under driver v001 or v003 (identical simulate plans), all > 80-node grids under v003.
ROOT (d): case C2 is the running call A2_ANCHOR_F3_RUN_V001 (driver v001, spec bytes = base spec, picard.passes 4) with a pre-registered Picard-equivalence condition.
ROOT (e): NOT_CONVERGED next step is the 5-6 /kpc extension with a prep successor (node budget >= 120) under separate review.
D1: pass needs Dhat34 <= 1 AND Dhat34 <= 0.5*Dhat23 (normalized statistic); per-row geometric tail reported as a diagnostic only.
D2: carried uncertainty adds max over passing shapes A of |v_i(A,4) - v_i(A*,4)|.
D4: the A1-m>=1 indicator bullet is withdrawn.
D5: the chi-square statement is restricted to the bias-squared term.
D6: a pre-named next step for each gate; picard.passes = 6 in every newly generated spec (bound 0.01 unchanged).
D7: bracket-rule precondition P6 registered with its deciding test and declared recovery.
D8: V3 compares each case to the REGISTERED common block (not to the first case present); the modal block is reported and every non-conforming case is named.
D13: m4 tie-break uses the driver's per-radius m4 restricted to the row window 0.4-6.0 kpc, with an unambiguous rule.

driver_equivalence_evidence.what_it_shows: For grids <= 80 nodes/axis v003 and v001 produce identical simulated stage plans (every stage row, argv, stage_globals, module_patches, mask), identical DRYRUN_PLAN.txt and identical simulated rows (v003 check s3: REPRO_PINNED_ADMIT_PREFIX 19/19, REPRO_PINNED_FULL 22/22, REPRO_RULE_FULL 20/20, KMAX_C2 12/12). The report fields that differ are not stage inputs. One computational-identity difference exists and is registered under admission_constraint below: at non-base parameters v003 annotates the per-call seed (c2_changed_fields), so the seed sha, and with it the route-A identity, differs between v001 and v003 (v003 check, correction 3). It changes no stage computation (no stage reads the annotation; v003 check s7).

anchor.definition: A2 seed-scan factor-3 point (gamma factor 3.0, rule c2v001), as emitted by A2_SEED_SCAN_G2_RUN_V001
anchor.picard_note: passes 6 in every newly generated spec (CHECK D6). The bound 0.01 is unchanged. The driver stops at the first pass whose max |change| <= bound, and through pass 4 its control flow does not depend on passes when a bound is set (serial and observed every pass), so a passes-4 call that stopped by the bound is the same computation as passes 6.
anchor.source: physical and brackets verbatim from anchor_base_spec (fe1ad000); identical blocks in every case.

grids_note: Grid blocks are byte-for-byte the V001 values; driver v003 DECLARED_LARGE_GRIDS was checked against them (v003 check s4).

bound_call.verified: launch.json pins.spec sha256 = fe1ad000... = sha256 of anchor_base_spec bytes = sha256 of the call's inputs/call_spec.json; pins.driver = v001 75b0c08a...; caps rss 3 GiB, wall 14400 s, output 8 GiB.

admission_constraint: An admitted case must run under the same driver as the cube call it admits. At the anchor the per-call seed is not the base seed; v003 adds the c2_changed_fields annotation, so a v003 call computes a different seed sha than a v001 call and route_a_custody() returns BLOCKED on the seed sha (v003 check correction 3). Hence S2 and Y2 (admitting C2 = F3, v001) run under v001; S3/Y3 and S4/Y4 run under v003. A BLOCKED admission fails loudly and is covered by the V1 next step.

fixed_across_all_cases.brackets: anchor.brackets, identical in every case (unless replaced as a whole by the declared D7 recovery block)
fixed_across_all_cases.picard: anchor.picard; the only admitted exception is the bound call C2 (passes 4) under criterion.picard_equivalence
fixed_across_all_cases.observation: column-mean V004 rows (HI-weighted mean of R*Omega, binding f42c7c65...)
fixed_across_all_cases.what_fixed_source_means: Observed Sigma, fixed analytic stars, the sigma0=11 km/s K0 rule and the 64/121 entropy factor are fixed. The gas state is re-solved self-consistently in every case (that is the forward map calibration will use). Route A (and so K0, body, roots) is cube-truncated at each case's grid edge by driver design (INTERFACE_C2_0466 s5); reference and body are also unmasked (driver lines 918-944), so sphere/cylinder cases are cube-prefix plus masked offset and downstream stages (v003 identity.truncation.scope). K0 drift between grids is reported, not hidden. Route A on G3/G4/GR uses prep v008 (byte-identical to v007 except the node-budget literal), on G2 prep v007.

criterion.tau_definition: tau_i = 0.25 * sigma_i per row (sigma_i = quoted random sigma of row i); root decision (a)
criterion.tau_picard_definition: 0.25 * min_i tau_i, absolute, on the driver's final-pass max_abs_change_km_s (unchanged from V001)
criterion.statistic: Dhat_A(K1,K2) = max over the 12 rows of |v_i(A,K2) - v_i(A,K1)| / tau_i (dimensionless), A in {cube, sphere, cylinder}; absolute km/s differences are reported alongside
criterion.relative_equivalent: reported per row alongside (d_i / v_i), not used for the decision
criterion.picard_equivalence: A case with normalized picard.passes = 4 is admitted only if it is the bound call C2 and its final-pass max_abs_change_km_s <= speed_change_bound_km_s (0.01), i.e. the driver stopped by the bound, not by the pass cap; then its trajectory equals the passes-6 trajectory. Otherwise C2 fails V3 with reason PICARD_CAP_NOT_EQUIVALENT.

per_case_validity_gates.V1: driver status COMPLETED, valid true, exactly the 12 registered row ids with finite speeds
per_case_validity_gates.V3: normalized_spec matches the registered case (grid block equal to the registered composite_grid_spec, truncation shape and kmax) AND galaxy, physical, coefficients sha, brackets and picard (bound, observe_every_pass, passes 6 or the picard_equivalence exception) equal the REGISTERED anchor block (or the D7 recovery block, as a whole, for every case) AND driver_sha256 is in the case's drivers_allowed set. Each case is compared with the registration, not with another case; the modal block across present cases is reported for diagnosis.
per_case_validity_gates.V4: final field packet wavevector axis equals the registered grid axis bitwise (prep formula) and holds axis_nodes^3 nodes
per_case_validity_gates.V5: final field packet rows outside the registered mask are exactly zero AND nonzero_rows_in_packet == mask_kept_expected (the count from the registered axis and the registered mask)
per_case_validity_gates.V6: admitted cases: route-A identity_sha256 equals that of the cube case they admit, and the admitted case ran under the same driver sha as that cube case

gate_next_steps.V1: Read the case's status and reasons. (i) monitor stop (wall/RSS/output cap): rerun the same spec in a fresh outdir with the cap raised under a separate approval; (ii) FAILED_AT_STAGE with a bracket miss in a column pass: the D7 recovery; (iii) BLOCKED ROUTE_A_ITERATION_NOT_4 or ROUTE_A_NOT_CONVERGED_AT_ITERATION_4 (deterministic): the matrix stops as BLOCKED_ROUTE_A at that grid; next step is a reviewed route-B successor that accepts the converged route-A iteration, under separate review; (iv) BLOCKED on admission (seed/identity): regenerate the admitted spec from the cube outdir under the cube's driver and rerun; (v) any other FAILED or REFUSED: one rerun of the same spec; a second identical failure is reported as a deterministic defect for review.
gate_next_steps.V2: Deterministic Picard non-convergence within 6 passes: rerun that case with picard.passes 12 (driver maximum, bound unchanged) admitting its own route-A, reference and body; if it still fails, report PICARD_NOT_CONVERGED for that case as a measured property of the forward map at that grid and stop the matrix for review.
gate_next_steps.V3: Custody mismatch: regenerate the spec from the registered block (generator or the hand-patch recipe in this directory) and rerun that case. For C2 with PICARD_CAP_NOT_EQUIVALENT: run C2' = anchor base spec with picard.passes 6 under v001, admitting F3's own route-A, reference and body; C2' replaces C2 and S2/Y2 admit the same prefix.
gate_next_steps.V4: Grid/prep defect: stop the matrix; review the prep v008 / composite-grid path of the driver; no rerun before that review.
gate_next_steps.V5: Mask defect (leak or over-masking): stop the matrix; review truncation_mask/apply_mask in the driver that ran the case (v001 has no runtime mask assertion; v003 has mask_fired_check); no rerun before that review.
gate_next_steps.V6: Admission mismatch: regenerate the admitted case from its cube outdir (generator admission_from_cube_out, from bytes) under the cube's driver and rerun.

bracket_precondition_P6.status: UNTESTED: the FS absolute bracket [1.5125e8, 3.025e8] rule and its 11 overrides were derived on the V004 chain; INTERFACE s6 warns the rule may not bracket elsewhere; A2 and the anchor change the route-A state.
bracket_precondition_P6.deciding_test: the FS (then RFS, LE) column passes of the first anchor call, C2 = A2_ANCHOR_F3_RUN_V001 (running).
bracket_precondition_P6.declared_recovery: On a bracket miss (FAILED_AT_STAGE in a column pass: bracket failure or 'no bracket source'): (1) widen only the missed columns' entries in the rule override block, recorded with the failed call's column enthalpies as evidence; (2) write a corrected base spec = anchor base spec with that one block changed; (3) rerun the failed call admitting its OWN route-A checkpoint, reference and body (admission checks parameters, not brackets); (4) regenerate EVERY case with --base-spec <corrected base spec> so the brackets block stays identical across cases (completed cases are rerun admitting their own prefixes). The corrected block, its sha and the reason are passed to the comparison with --bracket-recovery and recorded in the report. No threshold or rule changes.

criterion.shape_pass: Pass(A) iff cases (A,2),(A,3),(A,4) are valid AND Dhat_A(3,4) <= 1 AND Dhat_A(3,4) <= 0.5 * Dhat_A(2,3). With contraction ratio q <= 1/2 the geometric tail Dhat34*q/(1-q) <= Dhat34 <= 1, i.e. each row's remaining tail is at most tau_i; no tail is adopted.
criterion.tail_diagnostic: Reported, never adopted: per row q_i = |d34_i|/|d23_i| and tail_i = |d34_i|*q_i/(1-q_i) when q_i < 1 (else null, flagged non-contracting), plus the sequence-level Dhat34*q/(1-q).
criterion.m4_statistic: For the case (A,4): max of residual_diagnostics.azimuthal_harmonics.per_radius_max[j].m4 over radial nodes j with 0.4 <= R_j/kpc <= 6.0 (the 12-row window 0.49-5.92 kpc). Missing -> the case's m4 is null.
decision_rule: 1. Any registered case invalid or missing -> INCOMPLETE (name each case and failed gate, with that gate's pre-named next step; no threshold or rule change).
2. Dhat_R > 1 -> INNER_UNRESOLVED (next step: raise inner panel orders on the adopted grid; needs a reviewed prep successor with node budget >= 116 and its own review).

3. No shape passes -> NOT_CONVERGED (next step: extend the shape with the smallest Dhat_A(3,4) to 5 and 6 /kpc with the same order-6 unit outer panels, 108/120 nodes per axis; needs a prep successor with node budget >= 120 and a per-call cap >= 6 GiB, under separate review).

4. Two or more shapes pass but some passing pair differs at K=4 by more than 2*tau_i on any row -> NOT_CONVERGED (SHAPE_DISAGREEMENT; same next step, shape with the smallest Dhat_A(3,4) among the passing shapes).

5. Otherwise ADOPT A*: let m = the m4_statistic of each passing shape at K=4. If any passing shape's m is null, candidates = all passing shapes. Else candidates = passing shapes with m <= 1.10 * min m. A* = the candidate with the smallest Dhat_A(3,4); exact ties go to the registered order cube, sphere, cylinder. Adopted at k_max = 4 /kpc on grid G4.

6. Carried numerical uncertainty per row: u_i = |v_i(A*,4) - v_i(A*,3)| + |v_i(R) - v_i(C2)| + max over passing shapes A of |v_i(A,4) - v_i(A*,4)| km/s, reported with the adoption (with u_i/tau_i and u_i/sigma_i).
why_tau: Measured Picard floor of the saved chain is 0.0095 km/s (pass 2->3); the smallest tau_i (0.05 km/s, rows 06-08) is 5.3x that floor, so every row is decidable; the Picard gate 0.0125 = min tau_i / 4 keeps iteration error below a quarter of every tau_i.
A bias b_i with |b_i| <= tau_i = 0.25 sigma_i moves row i by at most 8.7% of the half-width z*sigma_i of the frozen 12-row Bonferroni band (z = 2.865), on every row.

The same bound gives sum_i (b_i/sigma_i)^2 <= 12 * 0.0625 = 0.75. This bounds only the bias-squared term of a 12-row chi-square; the cross term 2*sum_i r_i*b_i/sigma_i^2 depends on the residuals r_i and is not bounded by it (it reaches +6.0 at r_i = +sigma_i on all rows).

Per-row thresholds follow the quantity calibration uses (residual/sigma per row): relative to V001's uniform 0.05 km/s they are equal at rows 06-08, 1.5x at row 09 and 2-8x looser at rows 01-05 and 10-12, without loosening the per-row band shift or the bias-squared bound above.
scope_untested: S1 transfer across parameter space: adoption is measured at the anchor only; deciding test = rerun the adopted shape at K=3 and K=4 at the calibrated point before prediction.
S2 NGC3198: not covered; deciding test = the same matrix on the NGC route once it exists.
S3 outer-panel order: [2,4] panel order uncontrolled; deciding test = adopted shape with order-8 outer panels (104 nodes).
S4 route-A source azimuths (8; m8 bias -10.6% to +5.5%) held fixed, outside P-88.

D14 noise-floor non-contraction (both D23 and D34 near the Picard floor) is not given a floor clause; such a shape fails the pass test and lands in NOT_CONVERGED with the per-row diagnostic showing it.
